entities.summary: The Busan Cinema Center (Korean: 영화의전당), also called Dureraum, is the official venue of the Busan International Film Festival (BIFF), located in Centum City, Busan, South Korea. The about US$150 million center opened on September 29, 2011, almost three years after construction began.
